circle: return circle(center, { radiusMeters: 18000 }, { stroke: "#43d5c7", fill: "#43d5c7", fillOpacity: .18 }).bindPopup("Радиус 18 км").addTo(map);
circleMarker: return circleMarker(center, { radiusPixels: 10, fill: "#70a7ff", fillOpacity: .9, stroke: "#fff" }).bindTooltip("Точка данных").addTo(map);
polyline: return polyline([({ lat: 55.58, lng: 37.25 }),({ lat: 55.75, lng: 37.62 }),({ lat: 55.92, lng: 38.02 })], { stroke: "#43d5c7", strokeWidth: 5 }).addTo(map);
polygon: return polygon([({ lat: 55.58, lng: 37.30 }),({ lat: 55.62, lng: 37.92 }),({ lat: 55.93, lng: 37.78 }),({ lat: 55.88, lng: 37.22 })], { stroke: "#ffd37a", fill: "#ffd37a", fillOpacity: .16 }).addTo(map);
textLayer:
const features = [{ type: "Feature", properties: { name: "Москва" }, geometry: { type: "Point", coordinates: [37.62, 55.75] } }];
return textLayer(features, { text: feature => feature.properties.name, fill: "#e7f0f5", font: "700 18px system-ui" }).addTo(map);
tooltip:
const overlay = tooltip("Standalone tooltip", { permanent: true }).setLatLng(center).openOn(map);
return overlay;
svgOverlay:
const svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="#43d5c7" fill-opacity=".35" stroke="#43d5c7" stroke-width="5"/></svg>';
return svgOverlay(svg, demoBounds, { opacity: .9 }).addTo(map);
imageOverlay:
const svg = 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><rect width="400" height="240" fill="#102837"/><path d="M0 180 Q100 30 200 150 T400 60" fill="none" stroke="#43d5c7" stroke-width="12"/></svg>');
return imageOverlay(svg, demoBounds, { opacity: .8 }).addTo(map);
attributionControl:
map.addAttribution("Orihon demo source");
return attributionControl({ position: "bottom-right", prefix: "Orihon" }).addTo(map);
